lines.text: When I opened my door on my return, Flush threw himself upon me with a most ecstatical agony, and for full ten minutes did not cease jumping and kissing my hands—he thought he had lost me for certain, this time.
lines.note: Elizabeth’s dog Flush greets her with overwhelming affection after she returns home.

lines.text: This time, they brought me your letter at six o’clock yesterday evening: was I startled, or no, do you think, as I received it?
lines.note: Robert is startled by receiving Elizabeth’s letter at six o’clock.

lines.text: Here is a distress for me, dearest!
lines.note: Elizabeth is distressed to discover Flush has been stolen.
Robert asks whether Elizabeth forgives him, speaking as her own R.

lines.text: Only a few words to tell you that Flush is found, and lying on the sofa, with one paw and both ears hanging over the edge of it.
lines.note: Elizabeth reports that Flush has been found and is lying on the sofa.

lines.text: No, dearest, I am not to see you to-morrow for all the happiness of the permission!
lines.note: Robert tells Elizabeth he cannot see her the next day despite the permission.

lines.text: Ever dearest, I write a word that you may read it and know how all is safe so far, and that I am not slain downright with the day—oh, such a day!
lines.note: Elizabeth writes after an overwhelming day, relieved that all is safe so far.

lines.text: My own beloved, if ever you should have reason to complain of me in things voluntary and possible, all other women would have a right to tread me underfoot, I should be so vile and utterly unworthy.
lines.note: Elizabeth answers Robert’s wish to be better to her with gratitude for his love.

lines.text: Dearest, I woke this morning quite well—quite free from the sensation in the head.
lines.note: Robert tells Elizabeth he woke quite well and free from the sensation in his head.

lines.text: Your letters to me I take with me, let the ‘ounces’ cry out aloud, ever so.
lines.note: Elizabeth refuses to leave Robert’s letters behind, whatever the luggage weight.
